images.visualPurpose: Create a high-click, mobile-readable cover for a five-minute full-body kids workout.

images.generatedText: 5 MIN FULL BODY WORKOUT / FOR KIDS
images.prompt: Premium stylized 3D KidMotion YouTube thumbnail. Use the approved KidMotion boy identity: around 10 years old, medium warm skin, short textured dark-brown hair, expressive brown eyes, friendly confident smile, slim active child proportions. Outfit: bright royal-blue athletic T-shirt with lime accents, dark navy shorts, white socks, blue-and-white sneakers. Bright modern kids fitness studio with soft blue, lime and warm wood accents. Exactly one boy, large on the right in a strong static athletic stance, full or nearly full body. Left side contains large high-contrast text: 5 MIN FULL BODY WORKOUT and smaller FOR KIDS. No brands, no other people, no equipment clutter, 16:9 landscape.

images.visualPurpose: Teach a simple athletic squat-ready hold and establish the master exercise UI.

images.uiReference: this image becomes the approved exercise UI master

generatedText.title: READY SQUAT HOLD
generatedText.instruction: Bend your knees and stay strong.

images.prompt: Use approved Bild 01. Same boy/outfit/studio. Static pose: feet shoulder-width, knees visibly bent, hips slightly back, torso upright, hands clearly in front. Full body visible head-to-shoes. Keep top-left 220x220 clear for Remotion timer. Create exactly one bottom-left title READY SQUAT HOLD and one top-right rounded white/turquoise instruction cloud: Bend your knees and stay strong. No thought-bubble dots, no timer, no progress bar, no other people. This accepted image becomes the SECONDARY UI reference.
